INTRO DATE
SEPT 23,2024

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY: COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map
Number 12-L in the area bounded by:

The public alley at South Long Avenue north of and parallel to West 55
Street; South Lorel Avenue; a line 335.09 feet north of and parallel to
West 55" Street; the public alley east of and parallel to South Lorel
Avenue; a line 381.00 feet north of and parallel to West 55" Street: South
Lockwood Avenue; West 55! Street; and South Long Avenue

to those of an B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5300-5358 W 55th Street
5425-5459 S Lorel Ave.
5426-5458 S Lockwood Ave.
